title: The Fake Homecoming
author: Cyrus Okonkwo
blurb: Noor Eriksen, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must expose what the school board buried before graduation.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
